__comment: A plaque with a plan FITTED and some progress made. The glow states already encode that -- EMPTY means nothing is in the well -- so the parchment swaps in here rather than needing a second blockstate property. plaque_plan.png is deliberately UNTRIMMED (torn deckle edges, not squared) -- it is shared with RED, because both mean the survey has not passed; only GREEN, once the building registers, swaps to plaque_plan_sealed's trimmed sheet and wax seal.
